newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market volume up 33 pct in Oct.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market volume up 33 pct in Oct.

text.p: Volume on China's interbank renminbi market reached 75.7 billion yuan in October with an average daily turnover of 3.6 billion, up 33.32 percent over September, the Shanghai Securities News said on Wednesday.

The China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) changed little during the month on a consolidation, with the highest rise of 0.12 percentage points in one-day and seven-day contracts and the sharpest fall of 0.09 percentage points of contracts exceeding 20 days, the newspaper said.
The seven-day and 60-day rates traded the most in October, it added but gave no more details.
